description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project, specifically for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures on the RT288x-based devices. It defines functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades tailored to the board identified by 'board_name'.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that verifies the firmware image, currently always returning success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: A function to perform the firmware upgrade, calling the default upgrade method for the detected board.
